title: Round the dome
instruction: In build.mjs try dome() profile "bulb" or "shallow" with height 3 (must stay y<=8) and keep whichever reads as a dome, not a stepped pyramid in front-left.png; keep the orange red_sandstone_stairs band loop at y=T+1.

title: Wind tower taller and slotted
instruction: Replace the trapdoor vents with 1-wide dark_oak_planks slots 2 tall on each face and stagger two slots on the north/south faces; keep the red_sandstone_slab cap at y8 and the dark_oak_log stubs at x10 / x14.

title: Entrance steps and runner
instruction: Replace the apron stripes with a carpet runner: orange_carpet/white_carpet alternating at y1 for x8, z0..1, flanked by sandstone_stairs facing south at (7,1,1) and (9,1,1) as low kerbs, clear of the door line.

title: Awning valance
where: awning front edge z0, x2..6 and x10..14, y3
instruction: Add a slab valance: red_sandstone_slab / quartz_slab alternating, type top, at y3 z0 under each stair lip is not possible (stairs there); instead put open spruce trapdoors (facing north, half top) at y2 z0 on the 3 centre columns of each awning; check headroom stays clear at the stall mouths with mcd check.

title: Banner on the pier
where: entrance side faces, (6,2,3) west face and (10,2,3) east face
instruction: B.banner("orange", [["stripe_center","white"],["border","white"]], {facing:'east'}) at (6,2,3) hung on the dark oak jamb... the jamb is a log, so place at (7,3,3)->move lantern; mirror with facing 'west' at (9,3,3).

title: Back wall dressing
instruction: mcd paint: 'south ground row -> plinth cut_sandstone' and 'south openings -> surround timber' to give the 2 slit windows frames and a window box; run mcd diff --fail-empty and keep only if back-elevation.png looks less blank.

title: Side wall pots and a shaded bench
where: west and east faces, z3..9, y1
instruction: Add decorated_pot at (0,1,3),(0,1,9),(16,1,3),(16,1,9) and a spruce_slab bench (type bottom) on x0, z6..8 / x16, z6..8; keep the doorstep at z5 clear.

title: Terrace shade cloth stripes
instruction: The shade slabs alternate by x only; make them 1-wide stripes along z with white_carpet on the odd rows and red_sandstone_slab on the even rows, and hang two lanterns under it from the post tops (12,7,3) / (12,7,5).

title: Hanging sign check
where: (8,4,1) hanging sign under the centre viga
instruction: Verify with mcd zoom --at 8,4,1 --from n that the SOUK / BAZAAR text reads; if not, swap to signboard(g,"SOUK",{at:[8,4,2],face:'north',mode:'hanging',wood:'spruce'}).

title: Parapet crenel notches
where: deck parapet y6, front and sides
instruction: Edit the roof() call to add parapet crenels via paint 'roof wall tops -> coping slab smooth_quartz' only on x3..13; do not change the desert preset or deck material.
